paper.citation: Sourisseau et al. (2026), a global model of a Venlo tomato greenhouse at CTIFL, Carquefou, PLOS ONE

reference.what: the paper's global model's indoor climate, simulated with Dymola and DASSL as its section 3.7.2 says, and the measurements it is compared with

series.clock: seconds from 2014-01-01 00:00 UTC+1, the dataset's own

ours.tool: OpenModelica 1.25.0, the image research/modelica/openmodelica.py pins, with the libraries it pins
ours.run: from the season's start, as the paper ran its season, to the window's end, with results at its intervals alone, of MainAir.T and MainAir.RH

tolerances.rule: |ours - reference| <= tolerance, at every 300 s moment of the window, its two ends included
tolerances.why: a tenth of what the paper holds its model to against the measurements: a day's RMSE of 1.6 K and of 10 %RH (its Fig 10, after Baptista, 2007). A difference within them moves a day's RMSE against the measurements by no more than they are, by the triangle inequality.

also_reported: each day's RMSE against the measurements, midnight to midnight, ours and the paper's from the same series, beside the paper's own from its Fig 10 data; no tolerance holds them
